card.name: And in antibiotic prescribing warning
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "unlikely to provide benefit to the patient" in the antibiotic warning about prescribing without a proven or suspected bacterial infection. It comes just before "increases the risk of the development of drug-resistant bacteria".

modes.label: Antibiotic warning sentence
modes.description: The word "and" joining "benefit to the patient" with "increases the risk of the development of drug-resistant bacteria".
modes.example: cribing FETROJA in the absence of a proven or strongly suspected bacterial infection or a prophylactic indication is unlikely to provide benefit to the patient<< and>> increases the risk of the development of drug

card.plain: It marks the "and" in the standard antibiotic-resistance warning, just before the phrase about increasing the risk of drug-resistant bacteria.
